_: Sebraen in English: Zebra (a binary puzzle). «svart»/«hvit» are the two dots: black (filled) and white (hollow).
The squares from the start stay put.
For mange av samme farge i raden eller k: Too many of one colour in the row or column.
The board is full, but something isn't right. Look for the exclamation marks.
Brettet er tømt. Angre henter det tilbak: The board is cleared. Undo brings it back.
To like ved siden av hverandre – da må n: Two alike side by side – so the neighbour must be the other one.
Between two alike there must be the other one.
Tegnet bestemmer: = betyr like, × betyr: The sign decides: = means the same, × means opposite.
Kolonnen har allerede halvparten av den: The column already has half of one colour. The rest are the other.
Raden har allerede halvparten av den ene: The row already has half of one colour. The rest are the other.
Bare denne fargen lar hele kolonnen gå o: Only this colour lets the whole column work out.
Only this colour lets the whole row work out.
Med den andre fargen her blir det snart: With the other colour here, you would soon get three in a row or too many of one.
En vrien en: Her skal det stå denne farg: A tricky one: this colour belongs here.
Du har brukt alle hintene: You have used all your hints
One square was wrong. It has been emptied.
{n} squares were wrong. They have been emptied.
Fyll brettet med svarte og hvite prikker: Fill the board with black and white dots. Never three alike next to each other, and as many of each in every row and every column.
Ett trykk gir svart, neste gir hvit, og: One tap gives black, the next white, and the third empties the square.
Tre like etter hverandre – bortover elle: Three alike next to each other – across or down – are marked with an exclamation mark. So are too many of one colour in a row or column.
= betyr at de to rutene er like. × betyr: = means the two squares are the same. × means they are opposite.
To like ved siden av hverandre? Da må ru: Two alike side by side? Then the squares on either side must be the other colour.
Mellom to like er det alltid den andre:: Between two alike there is always the other one: black, white, black.
Når en rad har fått halvparten av én far: Once a row has half of one colour, the rest are the other.
Prikkene har ulik form – fylt og hul – s: The dots have different shapes – filled and hollow – so you can tell them apart without telling colours apart.
Stuck? You get three hints per board. Every board has only one solution, so you never need to guess.
Dagens sebra er den samme for alle: 6 ×: Today's zebra is the same for everyone: 6 × 6 early in the week, 10 × 10 at the weekend.
Med tastatur: piltaster flytter, mellomr: With a keyboard: the arrow keys move, Space fills, 1 gives black, 2 gives white, Backspace empties, H gives a hint and P pauses.
Black and white – never three in a row.
Like mange av hver i hver rad og kolonne: As many of each in every row and column.
Hvert brett er nytt og har bare én løsni: Every board is new and has only one solution – you never need to guess.
Trykk én gang for svart, to ganger for h: Tap once for black, twice for white.
The board is waiting for you.
Du løste dagens sebra på {tid} første ga: You solved today's zebra in {tid} the first time.
Alle i hele landet får det samme brettet: Everyone in the country gets the same board today.
Uten hint! Alle i hele landet får det sa: No hints! Everyone in the country gets the same board today.
Første brett på {str} – nå har du en rek: First board on {str} – now you have a record to beat!
